from __future__ import annotations

"""Provider-neutral payment rail capability registry.

The registry decides whether a rail may be selected. It never creates a
provider payment or becomes the payment source of truth; TrustPay retains the
intent, event, receipt, refund, and reconciliation records.
"""

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List


SCHEMA_VERSION = "liveuin-payment-rail-v1"
PHASE = "full-system-founder-payment-validation"


def _clean(value: Any) -> str:
    return "".join(ch if ch.isalnum() or ch in "_-" else "_" for ch in str(value or "").strip().lower()).strip("_")


def _truthy(name: str) -> bool:
    return os.getenv(name, "").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes", "on"}


RAILS: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {
    "stripe": {
        "display_name": "Stripe",
        "default": True,
        "countries": ["SG", "GLOBAL"],
        "currencies": ["SGD", "USD", "EUR", "GBP", "CNY"],
        "methods": ["card", "wallet", "bank_transfer"],
        "financial_legs": ["booking_payment", "deposit", "refund", "operator_charge", "localpro_payout"],
        "capabilities": ["checkout", "refund", "customer_payout", "operator_charge", "webhook_verification", "settlement_evidence"],
        "supports_stripe_presented_wechat_pay": True,
        "sandbox_ready": True,
        "live_gate": "LIVEUIN_STRIPE_LIVE_VALIDATION_READY",
        "provider_event_shape": "stripe_event",
    },
    "hitpay": {
        "display_name": "HitPay",
        "default": False,
        "countries": ["SG"],
        "currencies": ["SGD"],
        "methods": ["card", "wallet", "paynow_qr"],
        "financial_legs": ["booking_payment", "deposit", "refund", "operator_charge"],
        "capabilities": ["checkout", "refund", "operator_charge", "webhook_verification", "settlement_evidence"],
        "sandbox_ready": False,
        "live_gate": "LIVEUIN_HITPAY_LIVE_VALIDATION_READY",
        "provider_event_shape": "hitpay_payment_request",
    },
    "wechat_pay": {
        "display_name": "WeChat Pay Direct",
        "default": False,
        "countries": ["CN", "SG"],
        "currencies": ["CNY", "SGD"],
        "methods": ["wallet"],
        "financial_legs": ["booking_payment", "deposit", "refund"],
        "capabilities": ["checkout", "refund", "webhook_verification", "settlement_evidence"],
        "sandbox_ready": False,
        "live_gate": "LIVEUIN_WECHAT_PAY_LIVE_VALIDATION_READY",
        "provider_event_shape": "wechat_pay_event",
    },
    "salt_edge": {
        "display_name": "Salt Edge Open Banking",
        "default": False,
        "countries": ["EU", "GB"],
        "currencies": ["EUR", "GBP"],
        "methods": ["bank_transfer"],
        "financial_legs": ["booking_payment", "deposit", "operator_charge"],
        "capabilities": ["checkout", "operator_charge", "webhook_verification", "settlement_evidence"],
        "sandbox_ready": True,
        "live_gate": "LIVEUIN_SALTEDGE_PAYMENT_INITIATION_APPROVED",
        "provider_event_shape": "salt_edge_payment_event",
        "requires_country_coverage_approval": True,
    },
}

LEG_CAPABILITY = {
    "booking_payment": "checkout",
    "deposit": "checkout",
    "refund": "refund",
    "operator_charge": "operator_charge",
    "localpro_payout": "customer_payout",
}


def rail_catalog() -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        {
            "provider": provider,
            "display_name": config["display_name"],
            "default": bool(config.get("default")),
            "countries": list(config["countries"]),
            "currencies": list(config["currencies"]),
            "methods": list(config["methods"]),
            "financial_legs": list(config["financial_legs"]),
            "capabilities": list(config.get("capabilities") or []),
            "sandbox_ready": bool(config.get("sandbox_ready")),
            "live_ready": _truthy(str(config.get("live_gate") or "")),
            "live_gate": str(config.get("live_gate") or ""),
            "supports_stripe_presented_wechat_pay": bool(config.get("supports_stripe_presented_wechat_pay")),
            "requires_country_coverage_approval": bool(config.get("requires_country_coverage_approval")),
            "provider_event_shape": str(config.get("provider_event_shape") or ""),
        }
        for provider, config in RAILS.items()
    ]


def resolve_rail(
    provider: str,
    *,
    country_code: str,
    currency: str,
    method: str,
    financial_leg: str,
    environment: str,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    provider = _clean(provider)
    country_code = str(country_code or "SG").strip().upper()
    currency = str(currency or "SGD").strip().upper()
    method = _clean(method)
    financial_leg = _clean(financial_leg)
    environment = _clean(environment) or "sandbox"
    config = RAILS.get(provider)
    if not config:
        return {"ok": False, "detail": "payment_rail_not_registered", "provider": provider}

    reasons: List[str] = []
    countries = set(config["countries"])
    if country_code not in countries and "GLOBAL" not in countries:
        reasons.append("country_not_enabled_for_rail")
    if currency not in set(config["currencies"]):
        reasons.append("currency_not_enabled_for_rail")
    if method not in set(config["methods"]):
        reasons.append("method_not_enabled_for_rail")
    if financial_leg not in set(config["financial_legs"]):
        reasons.append("financial_leg_not_enabled_for_rail")
    required_capability = LEG_CAPABILITY.get(financial_leg, "")
    if required_capability and required_capability not in set(config.get("capabilities") or []):
        reasons.append("financial_leg_capability_not_enabled_for_rail")
    if environment == "sandbox" and not config.get("sandbox_ready"):
        reasons.append("sandbox_not_ready_for_rail")
    if environment == "live" and not _truthy(str(config.get("live_gate") or "")):
        reasons.append("live_rail_gate_not_approved")

    return {
        "ok": not reasons,
        "provider": provider,
        "environment": environment,
        "country_code": country_code,
        "currency": currency,
        "method": method,
        "financial_leg": financial_leg,
        "required_capability": required_capability,
        "reasons": reasons,
        "rail": next(item for item in rail_catalog() if item["provider"] == provider),
        "canonical_owner": "LiveUIN TrustPay/LiveLedger",
        "provider_role": "checkout_or_transfer_adapter_only",
    }


def status() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
        "phase": PHASE,
        "rails": rail_catalog(),
        "canonical_owner": "LiveUIN TrustPay/LiveLedger",
    }
